MATCH (p:Player) WHERE CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) <= 2018 AND CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) > 0 RETURN DISTINCT CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) AS col1, CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) AS col2, p.name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
